objective: State what application logging must provide, recommend a logger without mandating it, add a blocking logging handbook that Rex reliably loads for logger changes, and ship a swappable Logger port example tested in the o5 Node CI job.
why: ac6-1 to ac6-3 are not-verified. code-standards.md has no logging section and no rule covers PII or secrets in log statements. handbooks/README.md line 18 says general handbooks always load, but code-reviewer.md lines 375 and 402-407 make them candidates subject to topic judgment, so a blocking handbook could silently not load. The repo has no package.json and tests.yml has no Node, so ac6-3 depends on the o5 Node CI job. A portfolio survey on 2026-10-10 found one project on Powertools.

Advisory findings for missing logging on error paths and external calls
Make handbooks/README.md agree with the Rex discovery rule for general handbooks
